lgd_definition: "Working Dog" shall mean any of various breeds of dogs developed or trained to do useful work, such as herding animals or pulling wagons or sleds.
collar_tag_req: Every dog owner shall keep the tag issued for a dog securely affixed on the dog.
notes: Includes a definition for Working Dog which encompasses herding animals. URL: https://www.cobourginternet.com/assets/2021/Popular-Bylaws/021-2014-Animal-Control-1.pdf

collar_tag_req: Every dog tag shall bear the serial number and year in which it was issued... The holder of a Kennel Permit will receive a dog tag free of charge for each dog kept at the kennel and the tag will be attached to that dog.
notes: Kennels existing before January 1, 2009 are grandfathered. Standard animal control provisions. URL: https://www.cramahe.ca/media/ebmoua3l/09-01_dog_by-law.pdf
By-law #43-2024 is listed on the municipal website but the full text is not publicly accessible via search. URL: https://www.deseronto.ca/residents/by-laws-and-standards

collar_tag_req: Dog Licence requires purchasing a tag valid for the life of the animal.
notes: By-law establishes lifetime dog tags. Service and emotional support animals are defined in library policies but no LGD definitions exist in the fee by-law. URL: https://www.deepriver.ca/userfiles/file/47-2025%20-%202026%20Schedule%20of%20User%20Fees%20and%20Charges%20-%20Revised%203rd%20Reading%283%29.pdf

Full by-law text not found, but official municipal documentation states a dog is considered a nuisance if it barks consistently for a minimum of 10 minutes. No agricultural exemptions noted. URL: https://dryden-017-ca.govstack.com/media/wljhqbwz/barking-dog-form.pdf
BYLAW NOT FOUND. Full text of the animal control bylaw for Dutton-Dunwich could not be located.

collar_tag_req: Dogs must have a tag, including visitors staying over 7 days.
notes: Service animals are exempt from the maximum dog limit. No specific definitions for LGDs. URL: https://pub-douro-dummer.escribemeetings.com/filestream.ashx?DocumentId=1584

Defines "Guard Dog" strictly as a dog trained for security purposes, not an agricultural working dog. URL: https://dubreuilville.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/2024-13-ANIMAL-CONTROL-AND-REPEAL-2023-30.pdf

collar_tag_req: All owners of dogs shall ensure that an identification tag is appropriately affixed to each dog under their care. Minimum requirements for information to be included on the identification tag shall be: a) Owner Name b) Owner Phone Number
notes: Township allows residents to apply for an exemption to keep more than 3 dogs for compassionate reasons or service animal status. URL: https://www.ezt.ca/media/sgqddbzw/2008-035_caninecontrol_bylaw_vcurr.pdf

collar_tag_req: Identified as to ownership by presence of a tag or tags.
notes: Exempts hunting dogs from 'running at large' provisions while engaged in the legal pursuit of game and under the care and control of hunters, though no specific LGD definition is present. URL: https://www.twpec.ca/media/eb0fak1s/2016-85.pdf
